description: FULL BODY (head to toe). A Malaysian man in his early 40s with a clean-cut appearance. He is wearing a formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) dark blue uniform, including a peaked cap, silver badges on his shoulders, a name tag on his chest, and a leather utility belt. He wears polished black boots.

FULL BODY (head to toe). A Malaysian Chinese woman in her late 60s with short, permed salt-and-pepper hair. She is wearing a traditional floral-print samfu top with short sleeves and dark, loose-fitting cotton trousers. She wears comfortable black sandals.

FULL BODY (head to toe). An anonymous human-shaped figure presented as a featureless matte-black silhouette. The figure wears a dark hooded sweatshirt with the hood pulled up, obscuring all facial features, and dark gloves. A faint, glowing red digital glitch effect outlines the silhouette.
